Started playing young in 1999, inspired by his older siblings Atila "Tito" and Laszlo "[[Lalo]]" (founder of well-recognized Brazilian teams [[Savage Hunters]] and [[Try Again]]). bpx continued playing until 2005, though focusing mostly in QWTF.

He later engaged in multiple e-sports until 2013, both in playing and management, and came back in 2023 to inject the Quake scene with new ideas and projects.

After founding the [[BPX Foundation]] in 2023, he promoted tournaments in Quake Champions and in 2024 founded the QW team [[Psycose]] which is planned to expand to other games in the near future.

Based both in Germany and Brazil, he currently doesn't act as a very active player but is the main manager of [[Psycose]] and promote initiatives in e-sports throughout the year, including Quake.
